scripts.build:api: npm run build:shared && cd apps/api && npm run build
scripts.build:web: npm run build:shared && cd apps/web && npm run build
scripts.db:migrate: cd apps/api && npx prisma migrate dev
scripts.db:push: cd apps/api && npx prisma db push
scripts.db:seed: cd apps/api && npx prisma db seed
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd apps/vision && pip install -r requirements.txt
